# Operating Expenses (OpEx)

## Definition

Total costs required to run the business excluding cost of goods sold.

## Calculation

Sum of all operating expense categories: R&D, Sales & Marketing, General & Administrative.

- [Gross Margin](gross-margin.md) - Profitability before OpEx
